title: Ferdinand the Catholic to Jerónimo de Vich, AHN Estado 8715 N.45 (1511), N.57, N.60 (1512) and N.73 (1515)

steps.what: PARES search 'Vich cifrada' listed the ciphered letters; images fetched.
Aligned N.46 and N.52BIS with their clerk decipherments to rebuild alphabet and common groups.
N.57 read with the rebuilt key.
N.45 read; key extended, fug/fuq and plort corrected.
N.73: Spanish 5-gram annealing with groups split, whole, and as context breaks.
Terrateig 1963 searched by snippet; dates not found, book not seen.
Clear subscriptions give place and date matching the catalogue; content fits Ravenna, the 1511 promotion, the Navarre bulls.

N.41 (22 May 1510) cipher transcribed (109 lines, 2,758 tokens) with its clerk decipherment (n41_clear.txt); 8714 N.39 (13 May 1510, 1,365 tokens) and N.12 (30 Sep 1508, 720 tokens) images fetched from PARES, cipher and clerk decipherment transcribed. 8714 N.26 has one clear image only, no cipher online.

Aligned N.41, N.39 and N.12 with their decipherments (n41_align.tsv, n39_align.tsv, n12_align.tsv): all three use the 1511-12 key unchanged; ~85 new code groups (poi rey de francia, pum Roma, plirt ni, sol todos, gue alla, mox principes, pep remedio, fil ellos, sul tambien ...) and new signs q1=a, 11h=l, 6h=u, qto=l, B8=b, pi=m; N, /, 9to are sentence marks. Added to decode.py.

Re-decoded N.45/N.57/N.60 with the extended key and measured with measure.py (token coverage) and measure_sense.py (decoded words attested in Villa Memorias + Quijote + clerk texts). Token coverage N.45 0.977->0.983, N.57 0.969->0.974, N.60 0.933->0.940; sense words 0.855/0.860/0.802. Still open: '2' (101x, N.60 only), flort (56; conflicting me / confederacion), gz 37, phi 36, reg, fiy, mat, goi, none of which occur in the deciphered siblings.

N.60 re-transcribed from the images (v2, 11,592 tokens): old '2' = & (y), &2 = x; flort liga, fiy favor, fuy exercito, mat obligado added. q/q1 split applied to N.45 and N.57 (151 q checked, 69 -> q1). Token coverage N.45 0.984, N.57 0.976, N.60 0.948; sense words 0.858/0.865/0.824. gz, phi, reg, goi still open; pp. 7-15 of N.60 read only at 2x.

outcome.method: key recovered based on adjacent plaintext
outcome.method_basis: The nomenclator was rebuilt by aligning N.46 and N.52BIS, sibling letters in the same Vich file (AHN Estado 8715) that carry the clerk's decipherment on the following leaves, with their cipher; N.45, N.57 and N.60 were then read and filled in the rest.

gaps.detail: different system, no deciphered sibling; annealing with Spanish 5-grams failed. Alone caps the target below 0.90.

gaps.item: N.60 open groups gz, phi, reg, goi, sid and surviving letter garbles
gaps.detail: gz/phi/reg occur in no deciphered sibling; pp. 7-15 of the v2 transcription were read at 2x only and need a 4-5x pass

gaps.item: 8 no-bar q tokens in N.45 and 2 q1 missing from the transcription

outcome.fraction_read_source: measure.py over n12/n39/n41 transcriptions, n45_pp*_v2, n57_transcription_v2, n60_transcription_v2, n73 (0/3,177, other key): 26,434/30,559 = 0.865. Per letter N.45 0.984, N.57 0.976, N.60 0.948, N.41 0.971, N.39 0.948, N.12 0.994. measure_sense.py attested-word share (a floor): N.45 0.858, N.57 0.865, N.60 0.824.
outcome.notes: N.45, N.57, N.60 read with about 3-8% of groups unread (5-14% counting garbled stretches); N.73 not read. fraction_read measured roughly: 12,213 of 13,381 decoded tokens in N.45/N.57/N.60 not bracketed, over those plus the 3,177 tokens of unread N.73 (0.74).

prior.where: Terrateig, Política en Italia del Rey Católico (1963) vol. II prints Ferdinand's letters to Vich; not seen

human: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.
